notes.title: August 10th Patch Notes
notes.notes: We have noticed that some players playing the game while offline have caused cloud data to become unsynchronized, leading to some misunderstandings. We have added notifications to clarify this and introduced status checks. We recommend that players play the game while online.

notes.title: Experience Update : Avatar Display + Profile Lookup
notes.notes:
Optimized some artwork.
 You can now see your avatar in the leaderboard.
 You can now directly click on leaderboard players to view their profiles.

notes.title: Major Bug Fix
notes.notes:
Fixed the issue where the leaderboard could only store data for one level.
We apologize to the players for the oversight during launch testing that caused this bug.

notes.title: The official release version v01-Beta is now available, and bugs can be reporte
notes.notes:
The official release version v01-Beta has basic game features fully polished, and the ranking server has started operation.
If you encounter any bugs, please find the "About" option on the main interface of the game, join the QQ group, and directly report the issues to the developers.
